WITH movie_links AS (
  SELECT ml.movie_id, ml.linked_movie_id, lt.id AS link_type_id FROM movie_link AS ml
    JOIN link_type AS lt ON lt.link = 'features'
),
mini_biographies AS (
  SELECT pi.person_id, MIN(n.name) AS of_person, t.id AS biography_movie FROM name AS n
    JOIN aka_name AS an ON an.person_id = n.id
    JOIN person_info AS pi ON pi.person_id = n.id
    JOIN info_type AS it ON it.id = pi.info_type_id AND it.info = 'mini biography'
    JOIN title AS t ON t.id = an.movie_id
  GROUP BY pi.person_id
)
SELECT of_person, biography_movie FROM mini_biographies
JOIN movie_links ON movie_links.linked_movie_id = biography_movie
WHERE n.name LIKE '%a%' AND n.name_pcode_cf LIKE 'D%' AND n.gender='m' AND pi.note ='Volker Boehm' AND t.production_year BETWEEN 1980 AND 1984
